description: Image analyzer – extracts visual content, captions, entities, anomalies, and classification from images (JPEG, PNG, TIFF, BMP, etc.)

Description.description: A detailed description of the image content

KeyPhrases.description: Key phrases extracted from visible text or scene context in the image

NamedEntities.description: Named entities identified in the image as a comma-separated list of 'Text (Category)' pairs, e.g. 'Alice (Person), London (Location), Acme Corp (Organization)'

IdentifiedObjects.description: Objects visually identified in the image

PiiData.description: Any personally identifiable information detected in the image (faces, license plates, ID numbers); null if none

AnyAnomaly.description: Description of any anomaly detected in the image (tampering, unusual content, unauthorized presence); null if none

Classification.description: Hierarchical classification of the image content as 'Category > Subcategory > Tag', e.g. 'Security > Surveillance > NightVision'
